_note: Daily versioned benchmark snapshots keyed by date (YYYY-MM-DD). Written by the token-free GitHub Action (.github/workflows/benchmark-snapshot.yml → scripts/benchmark-snapshot.mjs), which calls the Worker's /benchmark-snapshot route (Meta token stays in the Worker, never in GitHub). Runs daily without the dashboard open. A failed run writes nothing (the day is simply absent). Backfill a missed day via the workflow's manual run with a date input. Trend arrows (rows 14/15/16) will read from here once a few full days exist. Seeded empty.
